caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular sign with a wooden frame and two black hooks at the top for hanging. In the center, there are two brown horses harnessed to a green and yellow carriage with large spoked wheels. The carriage is being driven by a man in a light gray suit and black top hat, holding the reins and a whip; a seated passenger wearing dark clothing and a hat is beside him. There are red, green, and yellow architectural elements on the left side, suggesting a building or backdrop. The background is a textured tan color with horizontal lines and a hint of green, possibly indicating grass. Across the top of the sign, gold-colored uppercase letters on a black band spell "STRANGERS RESORT." At the bottom, a similar black band contains the large gold-colored text "J. CARTER."
title: Inn Sign: "J. Carter" (verso)
